programme.title: Endless Love

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: At a Hong Kong shopping center, Buck Yuen's (Jackie Chan's) intuition warns him. He saves a robbery's loot and gets on television, ends up in Istanbul via South Korea, and accidentally becomes a spy. Fortunately, he knows Kung Fu.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is given the ability to resist the temptation from opposite sex but it becomes a burden when he is about to marry his girlfriend.

programme.title: Initial D

programme.title: Mr. Virgin

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After ambushing and killing his rival, losing everything in the process, dispirited warlord Hou Jie turns to a Shaolin monastery seeking salvation.

programme.title: Whatever You Want

programme.title: Whisper Of Silent Body
programme.desc: Forensic pathologist Qin works with his assistant and the police captain to resolve the backlog of cases.

programme.title: The Fate Of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This film tells the story of a Chinese illegal immigrant, Cheung Kwan-chow, and his journey in New York.

programme.title: Open The Coffin
programme.desc: A supernatural mystery film with a detective investigating murders that seem to be the result of a curse.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: The film revolves around a woman in her late twenties who rediscovers her talent for boxing after a long hiatus. She unexpectedly meets her former boxing coach and the pair work together to help her reach the final rounds of professional boxing matches.

programme.title: Royal Tramp 2
programme.desc: Wei the jester, turned undercover spy, turned high ranking official in the Chinese imperial court, tries his best to deal with warring factions and deadly martial artists all vying for power.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: During the Japanese invasion of China, a wealthy martial artist is forced to leave his home when his city is occupied. With little means of providing for themselves, Ip Man and the remaining members of the city must find a way to survive.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Liang Pao-erh joins the carefree Spinsters’ Club when she discovers her husband is having an affair. Despite the seemingly happy front that her sisters put on, beneath it all, each of them secretly yearns for a man in her life.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: A young Chinese warrior steals a sword from a famed swordsman and then escapes into a world of romantic adventure with a mysterious man in the frontier of the nation.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: The head of a rich family dies and in his will leaves his fortune to his daughter. His son is enraged and uses a rubbish collector who looks the same as his sister to steal the fortune. The Uncle's son also wants a piece of the fortune and coerces a small time thief into stealing the will for his wild scheme.
